steps.name: Check out the system under test
steps.notes: Clones or fetches, verifies origin, refuses local changes (never resets), checks out the pinned commit and verifies HEAD.

steps.name: Check the Docker engine
steps.notes: Docker Desktop must be the only engine: a native docker.service in the distro competes for /var/run/docker.sock (500 on /version, hangs). docker info reports OperatingSystem "Docker Desktop"; systemctl is-active docker reports inactive.

steps.name: Recover Docker Desktop
steps.notes: Only when docker-check fails. If a native docker service is active in the distro, disable it first (sudo systemctl disable --now docker.service docker.socket containerd.service): it was the root cause of the repeated wedges (2026-09-23).

steps.name: Prepare compose settings and host storage
steps.notes: Writes the .env password and operator uid/gid; creates .host/ as the operator.

steps.name: Start Dagster services
steps.runs: docker compose -f orchestrator/dagster/compose.yaml up -d; compose ps
steps.notes: Waits for webserver, daemon and postgres to report healthy.

steps.name: Start the host code location
steps.notes: Builds the Python 3.12 venv, checks git and libfuzzy, runs dagster code-server start; if the WSL IP changed it updates .env and recreates webserver and daemon.

steps.name: Check the code location
steps.notes: gRPC health check from the host.

steps.name: Reload job definitions
steps.notes: GraphQL reloadRepositoryLocation, retried for 60 s; required after every start and after pulling job code.

steps.name: nop (plumbing proof)
steps.notes: No run data, target or Docker; proves submit, queue and host execution.

steps.name: Define the engagement
steps.notes: Business goal, platforms, budget, scope and permissions.

steps.name: Grant permissions beyond read-source
steps.notes: Only when the engagement needs more than read-source.

steps.name: Create the run
steps.notes: New run ID and run-owned folders; runs on the host (ADR-0011).

steps.name: Stage the inputs
steps.notes: Records executor platform posix and fingerprints inputs; refuses legacy runs, other platforms and unimported evidence.

steps.name: phase1_intake (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Ops intake_config, intake_pre_validation, intake_work, intake_post_validation; in-process executor, no retries.

steps.name: Correct inputs after an intake failure
steps.notes: Inspect, correct, restage.

steps.name: repository_partition_discovery (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Supplied-result gate: accepts a valid, fresh map or fails with a hand-off; never invents the analysis.

steps.name: Write the partition map
steps.notes: Partitions, kind of code, persona routing, relationships, scope; SHA-256 citations.

steps.name: Install the supplied partition map
steps.notes: Refuses a target not at the record's commit or with local changes; never overwrites a different supplied file.

steps.name: dev_project_discovery (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Same gate pattern; also requires the accepted partition map at the same source revision.

steps.name: Write the project discovery
steps.notes: Project root, manifests, build image, safe command plan.

steps.name: Install the supplied project discovery
steps.notes: Same checks as supply-partition.

steps.name: Submit a job to Dagster
steps.notes: Allow-listed jobs only; refuses non-POSIX runs; records SUBMITTING before launchRun; finds an existing run by request and engagement tags instead of launching twice.

steps.name: Dagster accepts or rejects the launch
steps.notes: Queue limits: 2 runs overall, 1 per engagement. Validation errors come back as REJECTED.

steps.name: engagement_workflow (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Preparation workflow: config, intake, three preparation branches, validated join. Not a full lifecycle review.

steps.name: workflow_config (op)
steps.notes: Checks the engagement_run_id tag, takes generation ownership, records the attempt config.

steps.name: workflow_intake (op)
steps.notes: Atomic intake: configure, prepare, work (or reuse), publish.

steps.name: scope_check (op)
steps.notes: Preparation branch.

steps.name: native_plan_check (op)
steps.notes: Preparation branch.

steps.name: discovery_handoffs (op)
steps.notes: Preparation branch.

steps.name: workflow_publish (op)
steps.notes: Rechecks freshness, validates every branch, publishes the join.

steps.name: 02-build-index (designed)
steps.notes: Deterministic indexer: every build signal (build systems, toolchain and dependency declarations, CI and Dockerfile recipes, README build text), bounded and sha256-cited. Executes nothing. docs/processes/build-resolution.md.

steps.name: 02-build-plan (designed)
steps.notes: LLM reads only the index, the buildenv catalog and the schema; returns base image, apt packages, ordered argv commands, feasibility, all cited. Validated before anything is built.

steps.name: 02-build-resolution (designed)
steps.notes: Loop up to build_resolution_attempts (default 3): render Dockerfile, build image (apt mirror only), trial configure+build via B13 with no network; on failure the model revises. FAILED(BUILD_UNRESOLVED) when exhausted. On success catalog image_build_<id> and write the lock. build_image_reuse: auto | rebuild | require.

steps.name: build_discovery (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Cited build requirements and command arrays; nothing is executed.

steps.name: build_execution (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Standalone diagnostic: one CMake root only, via the buildenv-common wrapper, not B13. Superseded for S6 by batch E01.

steps.name: evidence_index (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Independent source branch; the index is a locator, never evidence authority.

steps.name: critical_findings_sarif (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Fixed-input transform to accepted SARIF; the final lifecycle publication binding is missing.

steps.name: ossf_scorecard (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Published-results ingestion (network pool).

steps.name: nvd_reference_sync (Dagster job)
steps.runs: schedule nvd_reference_schedule (every 2 h, UTC) or manual launch
steps.notes: Shared reference feed outside every engagement run; APPSEC_NVD_SCHEDULE=stopped disables the schedule.

steps.name: orchestration_smoke (Dagster job)
steps.notes: Pre-validation, work, post-validation smoke path.

steps.name: full_review (Dagster job)
steps.notes: The whole lifecycle graph (51 nodes); stops at the first node with no worker. Its per-node inputs and outputs are in Appendix B.

steps.name: Legacy evidence pipeline
steps.notes: Static prepass, native pregather, assemble, correlate, deep_confirm, retrieval plan; imported into a run by hashed import. Being replaced by the 02-* graph nodes.

steps.name: Dispatch LLM lanes
steps.notes: Hand-off files for the tracked prompt harness; lanes are not yet graph workers.

lifecycle_jobs.name: 13-fuzz-target-triage

declared_inputs.input: native memory-safety findings and native bundle coverage (from `05-native-memory`)
native compile-feasibility tier (Tier A/B/C, ADR-0001) and per-TU `control-coverage.json`, if available
existing test suite locations and any existing fuzz harnesses already in the target repo

output_files: **Target**: component id, specific function(s)/entry point(s), and the untrusted-input path that reaches them (cite the DFD trust boundary it crosses, if one exists)

**Benefit case** (why fuzzing here would likely find real bugs), grounded in evidence, not generic "parsing code is risky" reasoning -- e.g.: handles attacker-controlled byte-level input directly (decoders, deserializers, parsers, codec/compression code); has known-CWE-adjacent patterns (manual pointer arithmetic, manual length/bounds tracking, custom allocators); is in Tier B/C native-analysis coverage (i.e., IR/CSA/CodeQL substrate is weaker or absent here, per ADR-0001) so static tools are least likely to have already caught what fuzzing would find; has no or thin existing unit-test coverage of malformed/adversarial inputs; has a CVE history in this library or a structurally similar one (from 06's evidence)

**Cost case** (what it would take to actually fuzz this), concretely: whether a harness can reuse an existing test/example entry point or needs new scaffolding; whether the function is reachable standalone or needs heavy setup/state to call meaningfully; build integration effort (does it fit the existing compile database, or does it need new build wiring); realistic seed-corpus availability (existing test vectors, sample files, structured-input needed); expected iteration speed (µs-scale pure-function fuzzing vs. slow end-to-end harnesses)
**Recommendation**: `fuzz now` / `fuzz later` / `not worth it`, with the stated reasoning comparing benefit to cost -- not a bare label

a "known coverage gaps" summary section, in the format `07-red-team-adversarial` expects to consume directly: the areas with the weakest current analysis coverage (static + dynamic + manual review combined), independent of whether they end up recommended for fuzzing -- this is the required-input handoff to lane 07, not just this lane's own fuzzing opinion

sut-origin.path: remote Git origin of the system under test
sut-origin.about: Where the target is cloned from; fixtures pin it in fixtures/populate-targets.sh.

sut-pin.about: The exact commit the engagement reviews.

sut-checkout.about: Clean checkout of the target at the pinned commit; refused if the origin is wrong, the tree is dirty, or HEAD does not match.

compose-env.about: Postgres password, operator uid/gid, APPSEC_CODE_LOCATION_HOST (WSL distro IP).

host-dirs.about: Host-owned Dagster storage (compute logs, artifacts), created by setup.py as the operator.

docker-engine.path: Docker Desktop engine (the only engine; no native docker.service in the distro)
docker-engine.about: Answers docker version; recovery is wsl --shutdown and a Docker Desktop restart.

dagster-services.path: compose project appsec-review: webserver, daemon, postgres (127.0.0.1:55432)
dagster-services.about: Orchestration only: queue, state and history.

code-location.path: dagster code-server on the host, gRPC :4000
code-location.about: Host process that runs every op; started by code-location.sh start.

code-location-venv.about: Python 3.12 environment the jobs run in (code-location.sh prepare).

job-definitions.about: The jobs the code location serves.

loaded-job-list.about: Refreshed by code-location.sh reload; stale lists reject new jobs with PipelineNotFoundError.

engagement-definition.about: Business goal, target platforms, budget, scope and permissions, decided by the security engineer.

permission-grant.about: Required for any permission beyond read-source.

run-dir.about: Run-owned folder created by run_process.py --start; every later artifact lives under it.

artifact-manifest.about: The intake contract: target, project, goal, platforms, budget, permissions, executor platform (posix).

resolved-config.about: Intake job's resolved configuration; the job refuses if it changes before pre-validation.

partition-handoff.about: Issued when no supplied result exists: names supplied/result.json and its schema.

partition-record.about: Analyst- or agent-written partition map with SHA-256 citations (tracked for fixtures).

partition-supplied.about: Supplied partition map installed by supply_record.py after commit and clean-tree checks.

dev-handoff.about: Issued when no supplied project discovery exists.

dev-record.about: Project root, languages, manifests, build image and safe command plan (tracked for fixtures).

dev-supplied.about: Supplied project discovery installed by supply_record.py.

launch-request.about: Locked launch request; a changed request needs a new launch ID.

launch-intent.about: Durable intent recorded before the launchRun side effect.

dagster-run-queued.about: Acceptance: the run is queued (at most 2 global, 1 per engagement). Queued is not completed.

workflow-status.about: engagement_workflow generation ownership and its published join.

build-discovery.about: Cited build requirements and command arrays; nothing executed.

build-execution.about: One bounded CMake configure inside audit-buildenv-cpp (single CMake root only).

critical-findings-md.about: Fixed run-owned input to critical_findings_sarif (max 4 MiB).

nvd-snapshot.about: Immutable NVD JSON 2.0 snapshot, published every two hours by schedule.

legacy-pregather.about: Legacy evidence output, imported into a run only through explicit hashed imports.

buildenv-image.about: C++ build environment; provisioning is Phase 4.

buildenv-catalog.about: Base build images a build plan may choose from.

llm-invoker.path: PersonaInvoker: claude -p with its current login (subscription, never an API key), model Haiku
llm-invoker.about: The model call behind build-plan and its revisions; model and auth mode set in model-config.json (lane_overrides["02-build-plan"], invocation.auth.mode).

build-index.about: Bounded, cited index of build signals; the model's only view of the target (designed).

build-plan.about: Validated LLM build plan: base image, apt packages, ordered argv, feasibility tier, citations (designed).

build-attempts.path: runs/<run_id>/data/jobs/02-build-resolution/attempts/<n>/ (plan, Dockerfile, image id, exit codes, logs)
build-attempts.about: Every resolution attempt, kept on success and failure (designed).

build-image-catalog.path: data/build-images/catalog/image_build_<id>.json (+ container-images/ record for B13), outside every run
build-image-catalog.about: Host-local catalog of images that built a project, with every validated build; reused by build_image_reuse=auto (designed).

build-lock.about: Image id and digest, Dockerfile hash, ordered argv; replayed by E01/E02 (designed).

lane-handoff.about: Dispatches the tracked prompt harness for LLM lanes.
